setup.skills_note: skills_read = published app skills the agent opened in that task. skill_assisted = the subset with a rule written for an action or reading this task needs (our reading of each skill text); opening a skill whose rules do not apply to the task is not counted as assisted.

task.disclosure: The app adds .m4a itself, so Lusor typed the name without it and saved exactly the requested file; Google's grader looks for the file you get by typing the full name (.m4a.m4a). Mobilerun's fork checks for the name as written.
task.goal: Record an audio clip and save it with name "2023_06_24_training.m4a" using Audio Recorder app.
task.final_summary: I recorded a 5-second audio clip in the Audio Recorder app and saved it as 2023_06_24_training.m4a. The app's Information screen for the clip lists the name 2023_06_24_training, format m4a, and file location /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.dimowner.audiorecorder/files/Music/records/2023_06_24_training.m4a.

steps.note: Observe current screen and open Audio Recorder app
Open app drawer to find Audio Recorder
Dismiss intro and view recorder screen
Apply setup and view recorder home
Start recording, wait a few seconds, then stop
Stop the recording after a few seconds
Enter clip name (app appends .m4a) then tap Save
Tap Save to store the recording
Open records list to verify saved name
Long-press/more on the clip to view its file name with extension
Open Information to read the file name with extension
Read Information dialog for file name
